title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

  • Gestão de Equipe: Experiência em liderar e motivar equipes, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência no setor pet, além de formação em administração, marketing ou áreas correlatas. Certificações complementares e domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados também são valorizados.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.


Venha se conectar conosco!


A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Independentemente da sua, etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer


Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!


Quer saber mais? Acesse:


Sobre a Softtek : Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.


Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite

@Softtek no Twitter e seja nosso fã no Facebook

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript: para desenvolvimento de plugins e customizações.
  • Go, Quarkus: para desenvolvimento
  • Docker: para empacotamento e deploy de projetos CMS.
  • MySQL, Postgree e MongoDB: para integração com bancos de dados.
  • REST APIs: para consumo e exposição de dados via CMS.
  • Git e Jenkins/GitHub Actions: para versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Arquitetura e infraestrutura de software.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity

CAI Software is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, , genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

Disability Accommodation

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact us at or send an e-mail with your specific accommodation request.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. CAI Software does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of citizenship or immigration status in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA) .

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c).

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Operador de Extrusora
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando Operador de Extrusora para se juntar à nossa equipe em Itaquaquecetuba, SP. As responsabilidades incluem operar e monitorar máquinas extrusoras para produção de plásticos, assegurar a qualidade do produto final, realizar ajustes na máquina conforme necessário e cumprir com as normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Operação de Máquinas: Necessário possuir experiência em operação de máquinas extrusoras, ajustes e manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Qualidade e Produção: Conhecimento em controle de qualidade e processos produtivos para assegurar um produto final conforme especificações.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Frontend - Sênior
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada

  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript: para desenvolvimento de plugins e customizações.
  • Go, Quarkus: para desenvolvimento
  • Docker: para empacotamento e deploy de projetos CMS.
  • MySQL, Postgree e MongoDB: para integração com bancos de dados.
  • REST APIs: para consumo e exposição de dados via CMS.
  • Git e Jenkins/GitHub Actions: para versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Arquitetura e infraestrutura de software.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

CAI Software is an “EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.”

Equal Employment Opportunity

CAI Software is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, , genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

Disability Accommodation

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact us at or send an e-mail with your specific accommodation request.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. CAI Software does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of citizenship or immigration status in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA) .

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c).

  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.


Venha se conectar conosco!

title: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript: para desenvolvimento de plugins e customizações.
  • Go, Quarkus: para desenvolvimento
  • Docker: para empacotamento e deploy de projetos CMS.
  • MySQL, Postgree e MongoDB: para integração com bancos de dados.
  • REST APIs: para consumo e exposição de dados via CMS.
  • Git e Jenkins/GitHub Actions: para versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Arquitetura e infraestrutura de software.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail
